payload.name: Split-attention effect
payload.fact: The split-attention effect occurs when students must split their attention between multiple sources of information, which increases extraneous working memory load and results in a heavy cognitive load.

provenance.title: Reducing cognitive load by mixing auditory and visual presentation modes.
provenance.quote_or_locus: The split-attention effect occurs when students must split their attention between multiple sources of information, which results in a heavy cognitive load

provenance.title: The Split-Attention Principle in Multimedia Learning
provenance.quote_or_locus: The split-attention principle states that when designing instruction, including multimedia instruction, it is important to avoid formats that require learners to split their attention between, and mentally integrate, multiple sources of information
